high_level_description: The image shows two women standing side by side in front of a backdrop featuring the European Union flag. The flag is blue with twelve yellow stars arranged in a circle, symbolizing unity and solidarity among the member states of the EU. The woman on the left has shoulder-length brown hair and is wearing a light gray button-up shirt paired with black pants. She accessorizes with a gold necklace, a bracelet on her right wrist, and a watch on her left wrist. Her hands are clasped together in front of her, and she is smiling warmly at the camera.
